title: ROI2dataset
description: Transforms a series of ROI files to a node dataset

input_rois.description: ROI files to turn into a data set (space-separated list). This parameter MUST be the last one on command line.
input_rois.title: Input ROI files

keep_separate.description: Output one column (sub-brick) for each ROI value.
keep_separate.title: Keep separate flag

nodelist.description: Prefix for a set of .1D files that contain a list of node indices in the order they appear in an ROI.
nodelist.title: Nodelist

nodelist_nodups.description: Prefix for a set of .1D files that contain a list of node indices in the order they appear in an ROI, with duplicate nodes removed.
nodelist_nodups.title: Nodelist without duplicates

nodelist_with_roival.description: Also add the ROI value as a second column in .1D files output by -nodelist.
nodelist_with_roival.title: Nodelist with ROI value

label_dset.description: Write a label dataset instead of a simple dataset. Sets output format to NIML.
label_dset.title: Label dataset

output_format.description: Output format of dataset. One of: ni_bi, ni_as, 1D
output_format.title: Output format

domain_parent_id.description: Idcode of domain parent. Only ROIs with the same domain parent are included in the output.
domain_parent_id.title: Domain parent ID

pad_to_node.description: Output a full dataset from node 0 to node max_index (total of max_index + 1 nodes).
pad_to_node.title: Pad to node

pad_label.description: Use padding_label (an integer) to label nodes not part of any ROI. Default is 0.
pad_label.title: Pad label
